purpose: H4: isolate same-backend graph submission, final synchronization, and traced device execution using independent synthetic graphs; no target LLM timing is consumed.

execution.pair_order: alternate direct/profile then profile/direct using (config_index + pair_index) parity; each arm fresh process; sequential only
execution.cuda_graph_mode: native default; environment variable absent; actual direct/capture/replay mode must come from trace
execution.timeout_action: record still_running and stop scheduling new processes; do not terminate child or profiler; await root coordination

math.node: out[j] = 0.5 * out[j-1] + 0; distinct allocated tensor, src0 points to predecessor
math.independent_reference: integer numerator times 2^(-8-stage); no GGML CPU kernel or target data
math.validation: all final elements every first/warmup/formal call; all intermediate tensors after first and final formal; bitwise F32 equality required, finite required
math.quantization: none; generic SCALE controller workload only; not a quantized GEMM performance model

cache_policy.allocation: one graph and one backend buffer per process; fixed distinct tensor addresses
cache_policy.input_upload: once before first graph, timed separately
cache_policy.between_calls: full final tensor D2H validation and JSONL logging outside graph timer; no input rewrite, cache sweep, or per-node synchronization during graph compute
cache_policy.intermediate_validation: only after first and after last formal; first is followed by 5 warmups; no intermediate read within formal sequence
cache_policy.classification: repeated buffers; cache residency observed only indirectly, not cold HBM and not assumed identical across shapes or node counts

timing.clock: absolute Windows QueryPerformanceCounter ticks plus frequency; UTC is metadata only
timing.submission_to_completion_envelope: qpc_sync_end - qpc_submit_start; includes measured between-range instrumentation gap
timing.instrumentation_gap: qpc_sync_start - qpc_submit_end; reported, not silently attributed to GGML
timing.setup: CPU reference, backend initialization, graph build, allocation, H2D upload, post-measurement validation and output excluded
timing.clock_domains: never subtract Nsight times from QPC; link using exact semantic labels; perform GPU/API partitions within Nsight clock only
timing.double_counting: driver APIs may overlap GPU; submit/wait and kernel time are not additive

native_cpu_pool.applicability: native CPU pool only; synthetic CUDA-only graph creates no CPU worker pool. A single host submitter does not establish 16-thread CPU scheduler equivalence.

runtime.host_scheduling: normal process/thread priority; inherited process affinity captured from runtime. No new CPU pinning policy. Native --cpu-mask applies to CPU worker pool, not a synthetic one-thread backend caller.
runtime.hardware_fingerprint: actual CUDA properties + loaded driver module + external GPU telemetry before/after; expected values are not copied into actual fields

profiler.node_trace_reason: default graph-granularity tracing does not collect graph child kernel activities; node tracing is required for actual count and shape path
profiler.observer_effect: node tracing may materially perturb graph replay; pair with event-free direct. Difference is a protocol-conditioned observation effect, not automatically pure CUPTI overhead.

trace_required: all formal graph labels matched exactly once
actual kernels counted from CUPTI including graph child activity
actual graph-launch/capture/update and runtime/driver API counts
actual kernel names/grid/block and explicit graph dependence validation
no replacement of observed count by planned GGML node count
per-call kernel/API/sync/idle union partition closes within one Nsight clock
quality.failure_handling: retain missing, failed, timed-out and unstable pairs; no automatic coefficient output or silent deletion
quality.untraced_direct_count: null, not nodes; direct correctness does not replace profile dispatch evidence
quality.acceptance_scope: diagnostic protocol review, not final LLM acceptance and not evidence that every-cell Engine error is below 10%
quality.source_runtime_mapping: annotation-control build receipt and copied CUDA object provenance must pass before interpreting source geometry as runtime fact

further_arms: No event arm or graph-disabled arm in initial 6x3 plan. Propose a separately frozen diagnostic only if paired results fail to resolve a specific mechanism; do not merge its timing as native-equivalent.
execution_gate: Parent review followed by build/freeze and idle-window coordination is required. This directory currently contains preparation only.
